title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
authors: Sixu Yan, Shikang Wang, Binhua Huang, Xuanlai Tang, Guohua Fan, Fan Huang, Haoxuan Li, Yongkang Li, Yuhan Li, Bencheng Liao, Zeyu Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Hangxin Liu, Xinggang Wang

tldr.zh: AdaRoboVLG 将空间感知、Agent 功能推理和动态跟踪组合为统一抓取接口，再通过各手的运动学映射生成抓姿候选、用共享接触几何网络评分，实现无需重训底层模块的场景适配与跨手抓取。
tldr.en: AdaRoboVLG combines spatial perception, Agent functional reasoning and temporal tracking through a shared grasp interface, generates candidates with hand-specific kinematic mappings, and ranks them with a shared contact-geometry network for contextual adaptation and cross-hand grasping without base-policy retraining.

evaluation_scope.zh: 接口为物体几何、接触抓取描述 CGR（接触点、接近／闭合方向、宽度等）和目标手可用抓型。空间模块用 DINOv3 与训练后的 Contact-GraspNet 提供候选；Seed-1.8 Agent 结合抓型知识检索及分步推理选择目标、部位和抓型，再由 SAM3 落实三维区域。底层按手型查表做运动学映射，输出腕部位姿和关节角候选；PointTransformer 以接触点及法向预测稳定性，使用仿真成功／失败标签和 BCE 监督训练，无 RL。训练数据含 DH3、Allegro、Inspire 的 440 万次试验；共享评分器仍需各手预计算映射，不能概括为任意新手免适配。动态实现以估计的刚体变换更新初始腕姿、保持关节构型，绕过重新评分，非逐帧 Agent 重规划。真机使用 ROHand 和平行夹爪；ROHand 静态功能抓取为 102 个物体、510 次试验，成功率 83.3%，动态场景在线更新 5 Hz。主要验证单步功能抓取，未含完整后续工具操作或触觉纠错。代码、训练数据及预训练权重开放状态未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: The interface contains object geometry, CGR contact/approach/closing/width descriptors and feasible grasp types. DINOv3 and trained Contact-GraspNet supply candidates; a Seed-1.8 Agent uses taxonomy retrieval and stepwise reasoning, with SAM3 grounding objects/parts. Hand-specific lookup/kinematics yields wrist poses and joints; a shared PointTransformer scores contact points/normals using BCE on simulated outcomes, without RL. Its 4.4 million training trials cover DH3, Allegro and Inspire; new hands still need mapping tables. Dynamic execution rigidly transforms the initial wrist pose, retaining joints and bypassing renewed scoring, rather than invoking per-frame Agent replanning. Hardware includes ROHand and parallel grippers. Static ROHand functional grasping achieves 83.3% over 510 trials on 102 objects; dynamic updates run at 5 Hz. Validation concerns single-step functional grasping, without complete subsequent tool use or tactile correction. Code, training-data and pretrained-weight availability remains unverified.
